title: Rules 4(e) and 5: acceptance, finality and change authority

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause E; Rule five, hometown acceptance.
units.explanation: Hometown employee declare करे और Controlling Officer accept करे. Sirf postal address या birthplace enough नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule five, exceptional circumstances condition.
units.explanation: Change सिर्फ exceptional circumstances में authorise हो सकता है; unused option automatic right नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule five, Head of Department authority.

units.example: Section officer ने approval sign किया; पहले check करो क्या वो competent HoD capacity में authorised है.
